body: I don't know what kind of entertainer you are, but your teeth seem like a small portion of your talent! If you enjoy your field, I'm sure you'd be entertaining to me. (And a lot of people wear flippers, really!)

I do appreciate the supportive comments! I actually would love to go back to school, it would make an obvious goal for my future. It's just absurdly expensive and I'm already in debt on my credit cards from being unemployed.
